teaching.title: Programming Tutoring
bullets: Discussed debugging approaches during tutoring sessions focused on programming topics including variables and conditionals.
Prepared practice questions on variables, conditionals, and debugging for use in individual tutoring sessions.

projects.title: Recipe Organiser
bullets: Implemented a menu-driven recipe organiser in Python using functions and collections as a contribution to a team course project.
Tested representative inputs for the recipe organiser and recorded expected outputs as part of the team project.

projects.title: Memory Allocation Exercise
bullets: Implemented a small C systems program with explicit memory handling as a contribution to a team memory allocation exercise.
Traced program behaviour using a debugger for the memory allocation exercise; project tools included Git.
